correctness.rationale: Theorem 3.6 supplies exactly the two automorphism mechanisms needed. The pointwise diagonal-G orbit support is invariant under both. Equal supports can be matched by a marked Cantor clopen homeomorphism and then by a locally constant G-valued gauge that is identity near the filter points. Every support containing the r mandatory idempotent-orbits is realizable. This proves b_k=2^(q_k-r); Burnside and Stirling inversion are standard exact consequences.
